description:
## Problem
The validator accepts tuning that execution never applies (partitioning on PostgreSQL/BigQuery/Snowflake/Databricks/DuckDB; distribution and sorting on Redshift), while `capability_registry.py:174` itself records "render nothing at execution". Trino and Athena only warn because they are unknown platforms (`interface.py:1595-1604`).

## Change (per gate D-5)
- `validate_for_platform_detailed` reads the registry: `rendered_via="none"` or `:preview_only` → error "requested <type> is not applied at execution on <platform>: <notes>".
- Treat unknown platforms per D-5.
- Include the ClickHouse PK-prefix rule.
- Correct the registry entries for all no-op surfaces: Postgres family, Doris, SingleStore, Databend, Firebolt, Trino/Starburst/Presto/Athena, Synapse, Fabric, BigQuery (partitioning and clustering preview-only), Redshift (distribution and sorting preview-only), managed Spark, MotherDuck table tunings, DataFusion and SQLite constraints.
- Add a registry↔execution parity test from an MRO sweep that **follows `super()` and helper callees**. The text-only sweep had false negatives (plan review F4).

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- Only rules named in the D-5 addendum block.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`.
- Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit user approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop d39166ea.
- This item touches paths listed in the soundness manifest by `tuning-trust-paths-soundness-manifest-20261001`. The PR needs an external `Soundness review:` section (AGENTS.md) and must not auto-merge.
